notes.claim: The standard deviation is found by subtracting the mean from every raw value, squaring the results, averaging them and taking the square root.
Extreme values in the tails distort the mean, but they do not distort the median, because the median is based on ranks.
The mean is pulled in the direction of the skewness: when the right tail is heavier than the left, the mean is greater than the median.
